component.name: SC Character Databank
component.summary: Browse and install community Star Citizen characters

description.p: A native Qt 6 browser for the character submissions on star-citizen-characters.com, styled after Star Citizen's own interface. Search and sort the database like on the website and install a character into the game's CustomCharacters folder with one click.

ul.li: Search and sort by latest, most liked or most downloaded
One-click install and removal of .chf character files
Finds Star Citizen in Steam libraries (Proton prefixes), Wine prefixes under ~/Games and ~/.wine, and on Windows drives
Supports the LIVE, PTU, EPTU, TECH-PREVIEW and HOTFIX channels
Lists every installed character file, including ones added by hand

description.p: Not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games or star-citizen-characters.com.
Windows build, and detection of Windows installs including custom library folders from the RSI launcher.
